items.label: each
items.description: f applied to each item of x

items.label: each both '
items.description: f applied to x and y item by item

items.label: each left \:
items.description: f applied to each item of x with all of y

items.label: each right /:
items.description: f applied to all of x with each item of y

items.label: each prior ':
items.description: f applied to each item and the one before it

items.label: over /
items.description: f folded over x, the last result

items.label: scan \
items.description: f folded over x, every result

items.label: converge /
items.description: f applied until the result stops changing

items.label: do n times /
items.description: f applied n times

items.label: while /
items.description: f applied while cond holds

items.label: peach
items.description: each, in parallel over secondary threads

items.label: lj, left join
items.description: every row of t, with kt's columns where its key matches

items.label: ij, inner join
items.description: the rows of t whose key kt has

items.label: uj, union join
items.description: the rows of both, the columns of both

items.label: ej, equi join
items.description: the rows of t1 and t2 that match on the named columns

items.label: pj, plus join
items.description: kt's matching numeric values added to t's

items.label: aj, as-of join
items.description: each row of t with the last row of q at or before its time
items.example: aj[`sym`time;([] sym:enlist `a; time:enlist 10:00);([] sym:`a`a; time:09:00 11:00; px:1 2)]

items.label: wj, window join
items.description: an aggregate of q's rows within a window around each time of t
items.example: t:([] sym:enlist `a; time:enlist 10:00); q:([] sym:`a`a`a; time:09:58 10:01 10:05; px:1 2 3); wj[-2 2+\:t`time;`sym`time;t;(q;(max;`px))]

items.label: , (join rows)
items.description: the rows of t2 after t1's, the columns the same

items.label: timestamp to date
items.description: the day a timestamp falls on

items.label: timestamp to time
items.description: the time of day, to the millisecond

items.label: timestamp to long
items.description: nanoseconds since 2000.01.01

items.label: long to timestamp
items.description: nanoseconds since 2000.01.01 as a timestamp

items.label: Unix seconds to timestamp
items.description: a Unix epoch in seconds as a timestamp

items.label: timestamp to Unix seconds
items.description: a timestamp as whole Unix seconds

items.label: date + time to timestamp
items.description: a date plus a time of day

items.label: date to month
items.description: the month a date falls in

items.label: month to date
items.description: the first day of a month

items.label: date to int
items.description: days since 2000.01.01

items.label: timespan to seconds
items.description: a timespan as whole seconds

items.label: parse a timestamp
items.description: a timestamp from its text

items.label: parse a date
items.description: a date from its text

items.label: bucket times
items.description: times rounded down to five minutes

items.label: year, month, day
items.description: a part of a date: `year, `mm, `dd; of a time `hh, `uu, `ss

items.label: sorted `s#
items.description: marks x ascending, for a binary search

items.label: unique `u#
items.description: marks x's items distinct, for a hash lookup

items.label: parted `p#
items.description: marks equal items as contiguous, as on disk by sym

items.label: grouped `g#
items.description: keeps an index of where each value is

items.label: attribute of
items.description: the attribute set on x, ` for none

items.label: on a column
items.description: an attribute set on a table's column
items.example: attr exec sym from update `g#sym from ([] sym:`b`a`b)

items.label: remove
items.description: takes any attribute off
